section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: Welcome to Lead Awaker. This Privacy Policy explains how we process, use, store, and protect personal data in the context of providing our messaging automation services via WhatsApp, SMS, email, and Instagram, including the use of Artificial Intelligence for lead reactivation and automated communications. Lead Awaker operates in compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and, in respect of individuals in the United Kingdom, with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. References to the GDPR in this policy should be read as references to whichever of the two applies to the individual concerned.

section2.title: 2. Information We Process
section2.content: Lead Awaker does not directly collect leads for its own purposes. All personal data processed through our services is provided exclusively by our clients, who declare that they have a valid legal basis to share such data. The data processed may include: full name, phone number (WhatsApp and SMS), email address, social media identifiers (such as Instagram), interaction history, and other information necessary to deliver the contracted services. We do not intentionally process special categories of personal data as defined under the GDPR.

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
section3.content: Personal data is processed solely for the purpose of delivering our contracted services, including message automation, lead reactivation, AI-based message personalization, execution of automated communication flows, performance analysis, service improvement, and compliance with legal and regulatory obligations. Our clients act as the Data Controllers, while Lead Awaker acts as a Data Processor, processing data strictly in accordance with client instructions.

section4.title: 4. Data Sharing
section4.content: Lead Awaker may share personal data only when necessary to provide the services, including with messaging platforms (WhatsApp, SMS, email, and Instagram), technology infrastructure providers, hosting services, and automation or AI tools. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal data. Any data sharing is conducted with appropriate safeguards to ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws.
section4.aiContent: For AI-powered conversation automation, Lead Awaker uses third-party AI service providers, primarily OpenAI, L.L.C., together with additional providers such as Groq, Inc. used for auxiliary processing such as message classification and intent detection, and Google LLC (Gemini API) used for AI voice mode (text-to-speech and voice-to-voice replies). None of these providers use data obtained through Lead Awaker to train general AI or machine learning models. Lead Awaker has entered into a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with OpenAI under Article 28 GDPR, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as the legal basis for transfers of personal data outside the European Economic Area under Article 46 GDPR. For personal data protected by the UK GDPR, those transfers are made under the International Data Transfer Addendum to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses issued by the Information Commissioner, or under the UK International Data Transfer Agreement. Personal data hosted by Lead Awaker on its own infrastructure in the Netherlands is not transferred outside the European Economic Area, and transfers of UK personal data to the Netherlands are covered by the UK adequacy regulations, so no further transfer mechanism is required for them. OpenAI applies a zero data retention policy for API data: requests and responses are not stored and are not used to train models. Lead Awaker selects AI subprocessors that maintain independently audited information security controls (SOC 2-aligned).

section5.title: 5. Google User Data and API Services
section5.content: Lead Awaker offers an optional calendar integration that allows a user to connect their own Google Calendar. This connection is established solely at the user's initiative through our interface (Google OAuth). When a user connects their Google Calendar, Lead Awaker only accesses that user's availability data (free/busy) and calendar events, for the sole purpose of: (1) displaying available time slots to leads so they can schedule a conversation, and (2) creating, modifying, or cancelling the resulting booked appointments in the user's calendar.
section5.content2: Google access tokens are stored encrypted and can be revoked by the user at any time, either by disconnecting the integration or by revoking access directly in their Google Account. Lead Awaker does not use Google user data for advertising, does not sell or rent this data, does not share it with third parties except where necessary to provide the calendar feature, and does not use this data, directly or indirectly, to train general AI or machine learning models. Where a user's calendar is connected, Lead Awaker's AI assistant may propose available appointment times to leads in conversation; in that case, only the computed available time windows, never raw calendar events, descriptions, or attendee information, are shared with the AI service providers described in Section 4, solely to deliver the scheduling feature the user enabled.

section6.title: 6. Data Security
section6.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or unlawful disclosure. These measures include access controls, secure infrastructure, monitoring, and industry-standard information security practices. While we strive to protect personal data, no system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
section7.content: Under applicable EU and UK data protection laws, individuals have the right to request access to their personal data, rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data, erasure, restriction or objection to processing, data portability where applicable, and withdrawal of consent at any time when processing is based on consent. Requests should primarily be directed to the client acting as the Data Controller, with Lead Awaker providing technical support when required. Individuals also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority: in the United Kingdom the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), and in the Netherlands the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl). Individuals in other countries may complain to their own national supervisory authority.

section9.title: 9. Data Retention and Deletion
section9.content: Campaign data supplied by a client is retained for the duration of that client's engagement and is then deleted or returned on the client's instruction, in line with the data processing agreement signed with that client. Two exceptions apply: a minimal suppression record is kept for anyone who has asked not to be contacted again, so that the request can continue to be honoured and for no other purpose, and Lead Awaker's own business and accounting records are retained for seven years as Dutch tax law requires. To request deletion of your personal data from Lead Awaker's systems, email gabriel@leadawaker.com with the phone number, WhatsApp number or email address associated with your data. We will process deletion requests within 30 days. Where the data was supplied by one of our clients, that client is the Data Controller and we will forward your request to them and act on their instruction.
